_comment: Curation config for the position-inference step (built on top of rosters).
Maps KnowYourVote issue-question ids (see lib/survey.ts) to signal bills.
For each question, list signal bills. If a member SPONSORED or COSPONSORED
the bill, that implies the given `stance` on the -2..+2 axis. The inference
step queries each incumbent's cosponsored-legislation from Congress.gov and
applies these rules, emitting positions at the given `confidence` with a
sourcingNote and a NEEDS_REVIEW flag. This is a curated, human-reviewed
heuristic — it is not a substitute for reading the record.
Bill id format: {congress}-{type}-{number}, e.g. 119-hr-1. Find ids on
congress.gov. These two entries are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders — replace
them with vetted signal bills for the current Congress before relying on it.
